item.title: Junior Cartel Member Excited To Already Be Getting To Drive Boat
item.description: CARACAS — A young employee's burgeoning career took a massive step forward this week, as a junior cartel member was excited to find out that he was already getting an opportunity to drive the boat.

item.title: Mom Scours Toy Aisle In Search Of Perfect Christmas Present For Child To Break In Four Seconds
item.description: READING, PA — According to sources, a local mother was carefully looking through the toy aisles of a nearby store for the perfect present that her child would break in four seconds.

item.title: Art Of The Deal: Man Negotiates Mechanic Down From $75 Oil Change To $2,000 Full Brakes And Rotors Replacement
item.description: BORDENTOWN, NJ — According to reports, a customer at Tricky Auto Repair located on South Egg Harbor Road successfully negotiated his vehicle maintenance down from a routine $75 oil change to a mere $2,000 full brakes and rotor replacement.

item.title: Family Just One Accidentally Opened Hotel Water Bottle Away From Bankruptcy
item.description: ANAHEIM, CA — Dad and budget hawk Kevin Peterson told his kids that the family was just one accidentally opened hotel minibar waterbottle away from complete financial ruin.

item.title: Game Of Monopoly Narrowly Avoided
item.description: CAMILLA, GA — A routine family game night almost ended in disaster after a young child asked to play Monopoly. Fortunately for everyone involved, better heads prevailed, and the game of Monopoly was narrowly avoided.

item.title: Taylor Swift Hoping Travis Kelce Forgot They’re Engaged
item.description: KANSAS CITY, MO — Rumors swirled that the Kansas City Chiefs' disappointing season had led one of the world's biggest celebrities to reconsider her future, with Taylor Swift hoping that Travis Kelce had forgotten that they were engaged.

item.title: 10 Changes Coming To Warner Bros Films After Netflix Acquisition
item.description: After a bidding war, Netflix has secured a deal to buy Warner Bros. Discovery for a reported $82.7 billion. Once the deal is finalized, fans will notice significant changes to beloved WB properties like Harry Potter, Looney Tunes, and Superman IV: The Quest for Peace.

item.title: Jehovah’s Witness Family Takes Drive To Look At All The Houses With No Christmas Lights
item.description: PASADENA, CA — A family of Jehovah's Witnesses continued their annual tradition of piling into the car and going for a drive to look at houses without Christmas lights.
